data.overview: Beauty Success is a France-based cosmetics brand owned by Groupe NOVI. The only brand-specific evidence in the fetched sources is Good On You's sustainability rating, which places Beauty Success at "We Avoid" overall, citing weak environmental disclosure, poor labour-rights transparency, and no anti-animal-testing policy. No company-published claims or legal matters appear in the fetched sources.

papers.title: Beauty Success - Sustainability Rating
papers.summary: Good On You rates Beauty Success "We Avoid" overall, with a Planet score of 2/5, People 1/5, and Animals 1/5. It notes some use of organic and recycled materials but no ingredient breakdown, no biodegradability policy, no Code of Conduct, no supplier audits, no living-wage evidence, and no policy against animal testing in its supply chain.

findings.text: Beauty Success is owned by Groupe NOVI and rated "We Avoid" overall.
findings.quote: Beauty Success is owned by Groupe NOVI. Our “Planet” rating evaluates brands based on the environmental policies in their supply chains, from carbon emissions to wastewater

findings.text: It uses some organic and recycled materials but does not publish an aggregate breakdown of ingredients used.
findings.quote: It uses some lower-impact ingredients including organic ingredients, but it does not publish an aggregate breakdown of ingredients used. It uses some recycled packaging.

findings.text: There is no evidence of a Code of Conduct, supplier audits, or living-wage assurance in its supply chain.
findings.quote: There’s no evidence it has a Code of Conduct. There's no evidence it audits its suppliers. There’s no evidence it ensures workers are paid living wages in its supply chain.

findings.text: It has no certification, policy, or statement against animal testing in its supply chains.
findings.quote: It does not have a certification, policy, or statement against the use of animal testing in its supply chains.
